About

Systems first, then the emails that make them worth having.

I'm a CRM and email marketing specialist based in Abuja, Nigeria, working with teams worldwide. My work sits in the unglamorous middle of a business — the CRM configuration, the follow-up rules, the automation that decides whether a new lead gets a reply in minutes or gets lost in a queue.

My main focus is CRM management: building and repairing pipelines, lead-routing logic, and AI-assisted workflows inside platforms like GoHighLevel, Pipedrive, Real Geeks, Lofty, and kvCORE. Alongside that, I write and build the email marketing that keeps those systems worth having — sequences, campaigns, and copy that convert rather than just send.

I've worked across real estate, SaaS, and service-based businesses, which means I build for how a business actually sells rather than one fixed playbook. I work best with clients who already know their business and what they need done — I'm not there to sell you on automation, I'm there to build it properly and hand you a system that keeps working after I've moved on.

Case Study

Rebuilding lead response across two CRM platforms

Real Estate · Real Geeks + Lofty AI + kvCORE · Ongoing Client Work

From a multi-day lead backlog to same-day response, across two brokerages on two different CRMs

The Problem

Two residential real estate teams — one running Real Geeks, one on Lofty AI (kvCORE) — had the same underlying issue: leads were landing in the CRM but not being worked. One account alone had over 2,600 leads needing action and response times running past 50 hours, in some cases over a week.

What I Built

I audited both pipelines, rebuilt lead-routing and assignment rules, and configured automated nurture sequences (Lofty AI smart plans, Mailchimp-integrated drip campaigns) so every lead received an immediate first touch. I paired that with manual process changes — response-time SLAs, an escalation rule for unclaimed leads, and a weekly accountability review with agents.

MetricBeforeAfter
Average first response time53–81+ hoursUnder 2 hours
Unassigned / unworked leads2,258 backloggedCleared & routed same-day
Lead follow-upManual, inconsistentAutomated smart plans + email drips
Agent accountabilityNo standard SLAWeekly review + response-time SLA
